assertions: Actual ScFormulaCell results, original Excel error bytes/NaN and XML cached-value types use the existing model and shared token/string owners.
Original scalar/text/color/range/part-name XML primitives write and reopen committed worksheet-part bytes without a dummy filter/root/provider.
record.capability: Original Excel cached formula results and XML value serialization primitives
gaps: J0Z0KF connects the complete non-const ScFormulaCell::GetResult lazy/error-precedence method to existing ScFormulaResult/FormulaResultValue, and XclXmlUtils cached-result XML typing/spelling. Real SharedString temporaries, typed outputs, exact LOGICAL0/1 classification, Invalid inlineStr, SPILL-to-VALUE and complete Excel/core error-byte/NaN mappings are preserved. Native part-name, ARGB, UTF16-vector/range UTF8 and vector/ASCII Unicode conversions and raw WriteElement use actual shared owners/serializers. Static member objects erase deleted native utility constructors; existing ordinary Uint8Array UTF8 value transport does not claim a native OString or byte-buffer owner. Native encoded OUString construction and number(double) call actual SAL conversion/formatting with original flags, ownership and null guards. Request17 retains original formatter15-digit rounding; no host Number.toString substitute is used for numeric formula values. Full XclExpRoot/XclExpXmlStream, address-buffer/XclExpString overloads, font output, formula-expression serialization, workbook/model import/export and shell/UI acceptance remain unported or unverified.
